Subject: Room certification windows, transcoder handoff & credential flow for C-suite workshop

Thanks all — finalizing ops for the C-suite workshop (Dec 3-4). Two quick asks so we can publish the run-of-show tomorrow: 

1) Certification windows: we need a dedicated 90-minute window on Dec 2 (afternoon) in the Pacific Ballroom for an end-to-end systems cert — AV vendor, hotel network, and our BridgeOps transcoder. Please confirm availability and loading-dock slot.

2) Transcoder handoff: BridgeOps will bring a hardware transcoder as primary; Campbell Audio will provide audio DSP and RF mics. We want BridgeOps to have local admin creds for the transcoder and a NAT pin to our staging subnet for remote logs. Provide the minimal credentials matrix and the KVM access plan.

Attached: site_floorplan_v3.pdf (zones A/B loading dock), transcoder_runbook_v1.docx, vendor_credentials_matrix.csv

Mina
Event ops lead — Redwood Inference
mobile: +1 415-555-0192

Thanks Mina — we can confirm the Pacific Ballroom on Dec 2 from 13:30-15:00 for cert (90 minutes) and a 30-minute soft check at 10:00 the same day. Loading dock is reserved for a 2-hour slot starting 11:00.

On credentials: we will need a local admin VLAN access for the transcoder-only (no corporate access). Typical approach: ephemeral account for BridgeOps with start/end times + RDP to a jumpbox. We can supply the jumpbox and firewall ACLs but need the hotel network team to open the specific outbound ports for STUN/TURN and outbound 443 for our log sink.

I attached the staging checklist we use in venues like this — can adapt to your runbook.

Tom

Hi Mina/Tom — good to confirm these windows. A few venue notes: 

- Loading dock: access via Gate C, truck height limit 12ft; we will have a dock attendant from 10:30-13:30 on Dec 2. Please bring driver ID and vehicle registration.
- Network: we can open the outbound ports on a dedicated event VLAN with strict ACLs. Hotel policy requires devices with persistent admin access to be registered and have an indemnity form signed by the vendor (Campbell/BridgeOps).
- Credential handoff: we prefer a short-lived token (issued by our concierge) rather than static passwords. Concierge can issue tokens on-site during the 11:00 check-in window.

I'll upload the indemnity form and vendor onboarding link to the shared Drive folder.

Sophie
Director, Events — Hotel Harbor
phone: +1 206-555-0148

Date: 2026-11-27T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Room certification windows, transcoder handoff & credential flow for C-suite workshop

All — quick clarifications from our security checklist: 

- BridgeOps only: yes to ephemeral account. We will need the token to map to an audited user id in our logs (BridgeOps: please confirm the username format so it can be ingested).
- Fallback audio path: please confirm PSTN dial-in to BridgeOps and a passive analog feed to the house console. If the transcoder or hotel network has issues, we must be able to dial into the meeting host from a Redwood phone.
- Transcoder logs: we require 30 days of upload to our secure S3 bucket over HTTPS. BridgeOps, do you support incremental log pushes and a s3 presigned policy?

I updated an appendix in the transcoder runbook with those requirements. Laura — can you confirm the compliance steps with the hotel indemnity?

Marcus
Senior Events Program Manager — Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Room certification windows, transcoder handoff & credential flow for C-suite workshop

Thanks team — BridgeOps confirms: 

- We will accept an ephemeral credential token issued by Hotel Harbor concierge and map it to bridgeops-ci_user_{event-id} for audit ingestion (we will provide the mapping before Dec 1).
- Transcoder supports presigned S3 uploads; we will push incremental logs every 15 minutes and retain locally for 72 hours on the appliance. We will provide an S3 presigned policy scoped to the event bucket (read-only for Redwood).
- PSTN fallback: we will provision a PSTN trunk for the event and provide 3-digit dial-ins per host. We will also provide a clean analog split for the house console.
- Onsite window: our engineer (Evan) will arrive Dec 2 at 10:00 for setup and to meet the dock attendant. We request a 30-minute warm-up 10:15-10:45 and the 90-minute cert window at 13:30.

Action items:
- Hotel: upload indemnity & token process to Drive (Sophie)
- EventTech: confirm dock/port list (Tom)
- Redwood: provide the host phone numbers for PSTN dial-in testing and confirm the S3 bucket path (Marcus/Mina)

Evan R.
Head of Ops — BridgeOps
evan@bridgeops.io
